# AntiAway 1.2.1
This maintenance update makes daily schedules run automatically and reliably in the background.
## What’s fixed
- Starts and stops AntiAway at the scheduled times without opening the menu-bar panel. - Re-evaluates the schedule after the Mac wakes from sleep. - Recalculates the next transition when the system clock, time zone, or calendar day changes. - Keeps scheduling lightweight by waiting only for the next start or end boundary.
AntiAway must be running for schedules to execute. Enable **Launch at login** if you want scheduled activity to resume automatically after restarting your Mac.
AntiAway remains local-only and does not record clicks, typing, or screen content.

# AntiAway 1.2.0
This update adds automatic daily scheduling and improves the reliability of the menu-bar app.
## What’s new
- Set a daily start and end time for AntiAway. - Supports both daytime and overnight schedules. - Automatically starts and stops activity at the selected times. - Keeps the manual On/Off preference when scheduling is disabled. - Improved Sparkle update support and release validation. - Includes the updated menu interface and Close action.
AntiAway remains local-only and does not record clicks, typing, or screen content.
